description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter called NotesAdapter for displaying a list of notes within an Android application's UI. It manages note data, binds data to UI components, and handles user interactions such as clicks and long presses.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying Note items, handling view creation, data binding, and user interactions.

classes.name: NotesAdapter.NoteVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for holding references to the UI components of a single note item in the list.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Replaces current list of notes with a new list and updates the UI.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item_note layout and creates a new ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of notes in the list.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds note data to the ViewHolder's UI components for a given position.
